note: The geographic use is clear in this verse. Its semantic connection to כרר is uncertain.
summary: In Genesis 13:10, כִּכָּר designates the plain along the Jordan. Lot surveys the whole district and sees that it is well watered.

senses.definition: A tract of level land along a river.

evidence.note: The construct phrase כִּכַּר הַיַּרְדֵּן names the land along the Jordan that Lot sees, and כֻלָּהּ מַשְׁקֶה describes the entire tract as well watered.
